summary: A six-track tracker firmware aimed at chiptune and IDM, with chip-style, FM, drum and sample engines and patterns chained into a song.
features: Six tracks: pulse, 4-bit wave, noise, FM (one track), drums or sample
Patterns of 16, 32 or 64 steps, up to two effects per cell
Per-track tables, groove, Euclid and random tools
64 live effects in four banks, 11-type filter, FX sequencer
Four user sample slots loaded over USB, with a sample editor
MIDI clock in and out; screen in English, French or Spanish
